body.x: 8 companies supported by IITPA(Incheon IT Promotion agency(principle Seong-gap Joe, www.iitpa.or.kr)) achieved 23,893 thousands(USD) fruits at International Consumer Electronics Show, CES 2012 he;d in Las Vegas, USA.
(Photo: 'Robonova2' of MINIROBOT is drawing attentions of visitors)

CES 2012 that can catch up the trend of world home electronic market including IT trend, showed many kinds of New products of 3,100 companies, this is increased figure from 2,700 of last year. In particular, Korean's global IT status was great, next generation TV, OLED and 3DTV are leaded by LG and Samsung with the best innovation award.

CES held every January is a platform for business meeting and new technology announcement for dominating global market in advance. IITPA has been supporting small and medium businesses for 7 years steadily to enter global market.

The 8 companies supported from IITPA are VIVA KOREA(CCTV camera, DVR), Sechang Instrument(web personalization platform based on cloud), YUJIN System(security equipment), Huria(Bone Conduction headphone), PPYPLE(smart phone accessories like smart phone, handsfree holder and others), ChoisTechnology (PC control devices for presentation), Innoworks(plastic case, screen protector), Mini Robot(dans performance robot, robot-applied game machine).

Huria's next generation wireless products, which utilize bone conduction earphone, received a lots of attentions from American defense IT ware. Dance Robot of MINIROBOT drew many visitors's attention with fancy and elaborate dance. In addition, Sechang Instrument issued the challenge to global S/W market by showing 100% Korean S/W products.

Security CCTV manufacturer VIVA Korea is expected to get more outcome by getting attention of defense ware-related buyer. 8 companies supported by Incheon IT Promotion agency achieved 23,893 thousands(USD) fruits through 179 buyer consulting, and more outcome is expected through additional consulting.
Incheon IT companies located at Korean pavilion, Hilton Hall, CES upgraded their status and caught the eyes of buyers with competitive idea, technology and design which can appeal to customer.
